Title: Are Equipment effects done by the bearer?

Messages.Author: Rémi
Messages.Body:
Dear all,

I control a minion which has an equipment. This equipment does something, from the rule point of view, is the bearer doing that effect?

A few examples:
Name: Talbot's Chainsaw
Unique weapon.
If the bearer is ready during your unlock phase, this weapon inflicts 3 unpreventable damage on a ready minion you control.

Name: Black Gloves
Bearer takes 1 damage during strike resolution when this weapon is used, but only once each combat.

Thanks in advance,
Regards,
Rémi.

Messages.Author: Hobbesgoblin
Messages.Body: If I can hazard a guess, I would assume, in respect to the quoted cards "What is the soruce of the damage?" Is it coming from the Vampire wielding it, or is it environmental?

Messages.Author: Kushiel
Messages.Body:
Dunno if this is what Rémi is asking about, but this would work as a situation:

I have merged Helena in play (relevant card text: "Helena is immune to damage from demons"). I also have Abyssal Hunter (a demon) in play, which has equipped Talbot's Chainsaw (see card text above).
If the Hunter targets merged Helena with Talbot's three damage during the unlock phase, is she immune to it because it was damage from a demon?

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Kushiel wrote:
> I have merged Helena in play (relevant card text: "Helena is immune to damage from demons"). I also have Abyssal Hunter (a demon) in play, which has equipped Talbot's Chainsaw (see card text above).
> If the Hunter targets merged Helena with Talbot's three damage during the unlock phase, is she immune to it because it was damage from a demon?
>
No. The damage is inflicted by the Talbot Chainsaw, not the minion wielding it.

groups.google.com/d/msg/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/Mz_fcIldfAY/Ys_W0MtwqLgJ

This is a different situation from a demon striking with the Chainsaw, in which case the damage is considered to be inflicted by a demon and an equipment. Both Helena (immune to damage from demons) and Mictlantecuhtli (immune to damage from weapons) would both be immune to the damage of such a strike.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director
